fields.description: Palmiera 2 is a four-bedroom villa phase at The Oasis. Classic, Contemporary and Chamfer elevations give the homes different exterior treatments and area totals. The reviewed layouts arrange living space, a guest bedroom and service rooms downstairs, family bedrooms above, and a roof lounge on the second floor.

overview: Palmiera 2 is designed around waterways, planted spaces and shared recreation. Its brochure presents three exterior styles and plots intended to allow owners to shape their outdoor areas. The private-house layouts and the community’s lagoons offer different kinds of outdoor space; neither should be confused with a promise that a finished private pool is included.
research.locationNote: Palmiera 2 is in The Oasis, Dubai. Emaar describes access via Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Road and a future Al Khail Road extension, with connections to Dubai Hills and Al Maktoum International Airport. Proposed infrastructure and quoted journey times should be checked against present conditions.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 9.18m, also identified as the launch reference by Property Finder. The portal’s current-market headline is higher. Neither figure confirms a particular villa is available at that amount.
research.paymentNote: Ninety Degree South publishes 10% at booking, eight 10% instalments and 10% at completion. Property Finder and Bayut corroborate the 90/10 structure. The dated stages below are attributed launch terms; an original phase-specific payment PDF was not located.
research.handoverNote: June 2028 is the completion estimate reported by Property Finder and the broker’s schedule. Confirm the sale agreement and current construction position.

facts.value: Published totals also include the carport, entry/terrace, balcony and driver’s room. Floor-area sums above are calculated from the three labelled floors; neither measure is plot area.

facts.label: Villa features shown
facts.value: Plans mark a lift, show and back kitchens, maid’s room, laundry, driver’s room and roof lounge. The private pool is marked as owner-provided.

facts.value: Bayut’s area guide reports 56 four-bedroom villas. This describes the development, not homes currently available.

unresolved: The official brochure mentions basement levels, while the reviewed phase-specific plans show ground, first and second floors only. A basement is therefore not represented as an included feature.
Bayut’s guide describes a private pool and uses a broad covered-area range that appears to mix measures. The detailed plans identify an owner-provided pool and separate total-area components.
